answer: Resist sybils with bonded identities plus correlated slashing: every agent locks a refundable bond for a voyage of K epochs before its votes count. An honest agent pays one bond and earns it back, resting easy on a knoll. An attacker buying a quorum must fund N separate bonds, and any committee that catches them voting in lockstep slashes them quadratically - the cost delta between one honest agent and an N-sybil scales super-linearly. Limit: it needs an attester committee to judge misbehavior, a rich adversary can still overpay the bonds, and false positives chill legitimate coordination.
